name: – Anna Strolenberg – After § 21 – Am 17
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: 21a. Condemns the conflicts of interest between ownership/control of large media groups and the exercise of governing functions or political representation, which besides violating transparency and incompatibility rules, concretely prejudice the fundamental right of citizens to free and pluralistic information; calls on the Commission to ensure that the European Media Freedom Act is enforced in such a way to effectively prevent and penalise such situations, including through the mandatory divestment of media assets for major public office holders, and to systematically check that media ownership structures comply with EU rules on conflicts of interest;
